items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: I had a chance to work with him once at the White House... Bobby McFerrin

ctx.x: Oh yeah? Oh man, that’s good news. I had a chance to work with him once at the White House. They had the fortieth anniversary of the Newport Jazz Festival. That was a huge event, on public television stations and Joe Williams was there and Clark Terry, Wynton Marsalis, John Lewis, Herbie Hancock, Bobby McFerrin, Bill Clinton played saxophone on “All Blues.” It was funny.
And you were there? © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
